name: Bulldog Cubing 2017

venue.name: Harold L. Richards High School
venue.details: The competition will be held in the cafeteria

information:
There is a registration fee of $10
There is a limit of 120 competitors
This competition is open to everyone and spectators may attend for free.
The competition will take place in the cafeteria. Parking will be availaible at the school. 
Regsitration will be done through the WCA website. Once you have submitted your registration, it will be manually approved by the orginization team. Because of this, please allow 48 hours for us to approve your registration before contacting us.

*Registration on the WCA website must be manually approved. Please allow up to 48 hours after payment for us to approve your registration before contacting us. *

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the[ WCA regulations ](http://worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)
If you would like an in depth tutorial of what it is like when competing, please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dPL3eV-A0ww). Shoutout to Chris Olson for such an awesome tutorial. [CubingUSA's Competitor Tutorial.](http://www.cubingusa.com/ctutorial.php)

Prizes for this competition are supplied by thecubicle.us
